title: A comprehensive high-throughput screening approach for discovering inhibitors targeting the menin-MLL1 interaction.
authors: Loganathan, Tamizhini; Priya Doss C, George
journal: Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学研究menin-MLL1蛋白-蛋白互作抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白结合建模，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法可部分借鉴但与本课题TF-DNA核心关联较弱。
abstract: The prognosis for mixed-lineage leukemia (MLL), particularly in young children, remains a significant health concern due to the limited therapeutic options available. MLL refers to KMT2A chromosomal translocations that produce MLL fusion proteins. The protein menin, which is essential for the malignant potential of these MLL fusion proteins, offers novel targets for acute leukemia treatment. This study reports the identification of potential new inhibitors of MLL-mediated leukemia targeting menin through the screening of two distinct drug libraries and existing inhibitors. The 3D structure of the protein was retrieved from the Protein Data Bank (ID: 8IG0). The drug libraries, sourced from public repositories such as the 'Epigenetic Drug Library' and 'The FDA-anticancer Drug Library,' yielded top candidates like Tozaseritib and Panobinostat, which exhibited the highest binding energy scores in the Glide virtual screening module. Additionally, 31 known menin-MLL1 inhibitors were identified through PDB screening and subsequently docked with the menin protein. The top three inhibitors (M-525, M-808, and MI-89) were selected for further analysis. Five menin-ligand complexes were validated using molecular dynamics analysis and Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MM-PBSA) calculations to verify the stability and binding mechanisms.These findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of these drugs and lay the groundwork for future clinical development aimed at improving outcomes for acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients.
abstract_zh: 混合谱系白血病（MLL）的预后，尤其是在幼儿中，由于可用治疗选择有限，仍然是一个重大的健康问题。MLL指的是产生MLL融合蛋白的KMT2A染色体易位。蛋白质menin对这些MLL融合蛋白的恶性潜能至关重要，为急性白血病治疗提供了新靶点。本研究通过筛选两个不同的药物库和现有抑制剂，报告了针对menin的MLL介导白血病潜在新抑制剂的鉴定。蛋白质的三维结构从蛋白质数据银行（ID: 8IG0）获取。药物库来源于公共存储库，如“表观遗传药物库”和“FDA抗癌药物库”，产生了顶级候选药物如Tozaseritib和Panobinostat，它们在Glide虚拟筛选模块中表现出最高的结合能得分。此外，通过PDB筛选识别出31种已知的menin-MLL1抑制剂，并随后与menin蛋白进行对接。选出了前三种抑制剂（M-525、M-808和MI-89）进行进一步分析。使用分子动力学分析和分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM-PBSA）计算验证了五种menin-配体复合物的稳定性和结合机制。这些发现为这些药物的分子机制提供了见解，并为未来旨在改善急性髓系白血病（AML）患者预后的临床开发奠定了基础。
